title: Joint strum-prototype IO document
description: Machine-readable record of one E14-R18 joint onset+direction prototype run (ADR 0517). Carries no raw audio and no model weights (D5): only the corpus identity hash, the causal/lookahead contract the model was trained under (D1), the grouped split + leakage evidence (D2), the training configuration and measured wall-clock, and the prototype-vs-legacy metric comparison with its go/no-go verdict against the Chapter 14 Strum Alpha gate (D4). Enforced by hand-written validation inside test/tooling/joint_io_schema_test.dart (no schema-library dependency, ADR 0517 D8/D3) rather than a generic JSON-Schema library — this round ships no production Dart entry point for the validator to live in.

schemaVersion.description: IO document schema contract version. The checker rejects any other value as a typed error — never a silent default (ADR 0517 D3).

generatedAt.description: Timestamp the document's data was assembled, written by the evaluate script from the run clock. Not re-derived by the checker.

corpusId.description: Repository-relative identifier of the corpus directory (e.g. "ml/data/klangio"). The corpus itself is never committed.

corpusSha256.description: Hash the evaluate script computed over the corpus directory it actually ran against (same algorithm as evaluation/recognition/baseline_manifest.json's corpusSha256: sorted *.wav then sorted *.strums, each preceded by "<basename>\n").

matchesBaselineManifest.description: Always true: the evaluate script compares its own computed corpusSha256 against baselineManifestPath's corpusSha256 BEFORE writing anything, and aborts with no document written on a mismatch (ADR 0517 D6) — so a document that exists always carries this as true, never false.

baselineManifestPath.description: Repository-relative path of the anchored legacy manifest the corpus hash was checked against.

preFrames.description: Causal context frames the model sees BEFORE the decision point. Never counted as lookahead.

lookaheadFrames.description: Frames of audio AFTER the decision point the model requires before it commits to an onset+direction verdict (ADR 0517 D1). Zero means strictly causal.

hopMs.description: Milliseconds per frame hop the log-mel frontend uses (feature-extraction constant, not a measured result).

lookaheadMs.description: lookaheadFrames * hopMs — the same lookahead restated in milliseconds so the number reads without doing the arithmetic (ADR 0517 D1: the report and the schema must carry the SAME number in both units).

note.description: Free-text statement of what the lookahead buys architecturally (e.g. why it is smaller than the legacy direction classifier's post-onset window).

method.description: Grouped split by player id (ml/klangio.py::guitarist_of / logo_folds, ADR 0517 D2) — one representative fold of the LOGO sweep, not the full multi-fold sweep (compute budget, §0.0/R8).

heldOutGuitarist.description: The guitarist id (leading digit of the recording ids) held out entirely from training.

leakageCheckPassed.description: Always true: the evaluate script asserts the train and test guitarist-id sets are disjoint and aborts with no document written when they are not (ADR 0517 D2 fail-closed) — a document that exists always carries this as true.

leakageCheckMethod.description: Free-text description of the assertion that produced leakageCheckPassed.

epochs.description: Epochs actually run (EarlyStopping may stop before the configured cap).

wallClockSeconds.description: Measured wall-clock of the documented run this document reports on (§0.0/R8: the whole run must be <= 1200s).

text.description: What the metric means and how it was computed — travels with the number, not only in a source comment (ADR 0517 D7).

higherIsBetter.description: Direction of improvement for this metric (ADR 0517 D7).

n.description: Count of elements the value was measured/derived over. n=0 is never valid: a metric with nothing behind it is not measured.

sourceFile.description: Where the value was measured/anchored, when it did not come from this run's own evaluate script.

bound.description: Present only on a metric that is NOT a direct measurement but a derived ceiling (ADR 0517 D6) — e.g. the legacy end-to-end direction row, which does not exist as a measured number on this corpus.

derivation.description: Required together with "bound": the explicit reasoning that produced the ceiling, so it can never be read as a measurement (ADR 0517 D6).

oneOf.description: A directly measured/derived value: no bound marker.
A derived ceiling: bound and its derivation are both required together.

onsetF1At50ms.description: Chapter 14 §7.2 Strum Alpha gate literal (docs/sdd/14-chapter-14-recognition-ui-recovery.md). A literal, never computed by arithmetic (ADR 0517 D4, L637).

directionMacroF1.description: Chapter 14 §7.2 Strum Alpha gate literal. A literal, never computed by arithmetic (ADR 0517 D4, L637).

decision.description: "go" iff BOTH comparisons are "at" or "above" (the threshold is inclusive, ADR 0517 D4) — "below" on either metric is "no-go", including a near-miss.
